the prison library Andy builds book by book

Fluffy scones packed with vintage cheddar and chives, baked golden with a cheesy crust, split warm and served with butter and apple chutney. Heat the oven to 220C. Rub 60g cold butter into 375g self-raising flour with half a tsp salt. Stir in 120g grated vintage cheddar and 2 tbsp chives, then 250ml milk to a soft dough. Pat out 3cm thick and cut 10 rounds. Place close together on a lined tray, brush with milk and sprinkle with 30g more cheddar. Bake 15 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with butter and 150g apple chutney.
M: Beef chuck stewed with potatoes, carrots and onions in a thick gravy, ladled out with bread.
the warm Pacific town Andy dreams about

White fish rubbed with chilli, cumin and lime, chargrilled and flaked into warm corn tortillas with cabbage, pineapple salsa and lime crema. Rub 600g firm white fish fillets with 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, oil, salt and lime zest. Dice 200g pineapple with half a red onion, 1 chopped chilli, coriander and lime juice. Shred a quarter of a cabbage. Mix 150g sour cream with the juice of 1 lime. Grill the fish on a hot oiled plate for 3 minutes a side and flake. Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

Ice-cold lager topped with spicy ginger beer, fresh lime and a few slices of ginger, served in frosted glasses in the sun. Put 4 glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Slice a 3cm knob of ginger into thin coins and cut 2 limes into wedges. Pour 200ml cold lager into each glass, then top with 150ml cold ginger beer. Squeeze in a lime wedge and add 2 ginger coins to each glass. For anyone not drinking, use all ginger beer with extra lime.

s.how: Heat a greased 25cm pan in the oven at 210C. Mix 200g cornmeal, 125g flour, 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt with 350ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 80g melted butter. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes, then cut into squares and serve with butter.

s.note: the beach town Andy dreams about
s.how: Mash 3 ripe avocados roughly with the juice of 2 limes and salt. Stir in half a finely diced red onion, 1 diced jalapeño and a handful of chopped coriander. Serve straight away with 230g warm corn chips.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches, then soften 2 onions. Return the beef with 2 tbsp flour, 750ml beef stock, 600g potatoes and 3 carrots in chunks. Cover and simmer 2 hours until tender. Ladle into bowls with thick white bread.

w.note: a nod to the little rock hammer
w.how: Melt 400g milk chocolate gently. Stir in 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted peanuts and 100g broken plain biscuits. Spread into a lined 20cm tin, chill 2 hours until set and cut into rough rocks.
